learning_outcomes.text: Identify the components and materials used in pneumatic installations and know their characteristics.
Know and apply specific regulations related to pneumatic installations.
Able to design pneumatic installations, complying with current regulations and pre-established requirements.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Introduction. Industrial installations. Actuators. Valves. Signal capture elements. Various components. Fittings, pipes and accessories. Basic pneumatic circuits. Design of pneumatic circuits. Systematic design methods. Vacuum techniques.
teaching_methods: Personal study, report writing, practical work
assessment_rules: The final grade is the sum of 8 practice exercises (8% each) and 2 exams (17.5% each). A minimum score of 3.5 is required for each exam. The student passes the course if the average grade is equal to or greater than 5. In the ordinary resit, grades equal to or greater than 5 for either the practices or exams part are kept, and the student only retakes the failed part. In the extraordinary resit, the student takes the entire subject again.
